definitions.meaning: Appendix A: asset is accessible to unauthenticated or untrusted entities via public networks. If any one method (e.g. CDM or Cyber Hygiene) finds it publicly exposed, the value is Yes. Directive Definitions section: any agency-owned or agency-managed IT resource accessible to unauthenticated or untrusted entities via public networks such as the internet, regardless of physical or logical location. (close paraphrase)
Appendix A: otherwise (not accessible as above).
Appendix A: the CVE ID has an entry in CISA's KEV Catalog; inclusion criteria unchanged. (paraphrase)

Appendix A: defined as documented by the Vulnrichment Program (links to CERTCC/SSVC on GitHub); Background: whether an adversary can automate all steps needed to exploit. Value definitions not on the page itself. (paraphrase)
Definitions section: the exploit gives the adversary total control over the software's behavior, including if it reliably reveals log-in credentials. (close paraphrase)

Definitions section: limited control over, or information exposure about, the software's behavior, or a low stochastic opportunity for total control; denial of service is a form of limited control. (close paraphrase)
Appendix A: fix the next time the asset gets a scheduled major upgrade or rebuild, unless conditions change. (paraphrase)
Appendix A: complete remediation or mitigation within the timeline (3 days) and also perform forensic triage of the asset. (paraphrase)
Appendix A: calendar days; clock starts when CISA adds the CVE to KEV or the agency identifies the vulnerability on an asset and updates the CDM dashboard, whichever is first. (paraphrase)
